source_text: αὐτὸς δέ, ἵνα καταργήσῃ τὸν θάνατον καὶ τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀνάστασιν δείξῃ, ὅτι ἐν σαρκὶ ἔδει αὐτὸν φανερωθῆναι, ὑπέμεινεν, ἵνα τοῖς πατράσιν τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν ἀποδῷ, καὶ αὐτὸς ἑαυτῷ τὸν λαὸν τὸν καινὸν ἑτοιμάζων ἐπιδείξῃ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὤν, ὅτι τὴν ἀνάστασιν αὐτὸς ποιήσας κρινεῖ.
pass_a_gloss: and he himself, in order that he may-abolish the death and the from dead ones rising he may-show, that in flesh it-was-necessary him to-be-manifested, he endured, in order that to the fathers the promise he may-give-back, and he himself for himself the people the new preparing he may-show upon the earth being, that the rising he himself having-made will-judge.
pass_b_english: And he himself endured — so that he might abolish death and show the rising from the dead — because he had to be made visible in flesh, so that he might pay the promise to the fathers, and so that, preparing a new people for himself while he was on the earth, he might show that he himself, having made the resurrection, will judge.

choices.why: Pauline force without 'make of no effect' stiffness.
